expected_level_description: You can: - write and lead people plans for a directorate in line with the people strategy - advise senior leaders on people risks and priorities - lead part of the HR function, setting its standards and priorities

You can: - lead organisation-wide restructures and service transfers - design the organisation's approach to change, including partnership working - advise the board on the people impact and risk of major change

You can: - set the organisation's workforce strategy and long-term plan - make workforce trade-offs across services with finance and service leaders - shape workforce plans with partners across the health and care system

You can: - lead the organisation's approach to employee relations and partnership working - handle the most sensitive or high-risk cases, including employment claims - negotiate collective agreements and resolve collective disputes

You can: - set the organisation's people policy framework and approach to legal risk - anticipate changes in employment law and plan the organisation's response - advise the board on employment risk and liability

You can: - diagnose organisational issues and design interventions to address them - lead team development, leadership development, and engagement programmes - evaluate the effect of interventions using evidence

You can: - make decisions characterised by medium levels of risk and complexity and recommend decisions as risk and complexity increase - build consensus between services or independent stakeholders - identify problems or issues in the team dynamic and rectify them - engage in varying types of feedback, choosing the right type at the appropriate time and ensuring the discussion and decision stick - bring people together to form a motivated team and help create the right environment for a team to work in - facilitate the best team makeup depending on the situation
You can: - lead managers and shape the culture of a large area - design workforce plans and organisational change - coach leaders and resolve complex people issues
You can: - hold and manage a budget, forecasting and explaining variances - build a business case with costs and benefits
You can: - run the risk process for a directorate or programme - assess risks against the risk appetite and escalate them - report on risks to committees
